name: Internet-exposed EC2 instances
cypher: MATCH (a:AWSAccount)-[r:RESOURCE]->(i:EC2Instance) WHERE i.exposed_internet = true RETURN a, r, i

name: Publicly readable S3 buckets
cypher: MATCH (a:AWSAccount)-[r:RESOURCE]->(b:S3Bucket) WHERE b.anonymous_access = true RETURN a, r, b

name: GitHub repos that can assume AWS roles
GitHub users without 2FA
cypher: MATCH p=(u:GitHubUser)-[]->(o:GitHubOrganization) WHERE u.has_2fa_enabled = false RETURN p

name: Okta groups mapped to AWS roles
Outside collaborators with write access
cypher: MATCH p=(u:GitHubUser)-[r]->(repo:GitHubRepository) WHERE type(r) STARTS WITH 'OUTSIDE_COLLAB' RETURN p
